# LOS146 saved-generation investigation cards

Status: **AUTHORED UNRUN** against installed Core, SDK transport and a real
Codex/Claude client. Pure doubles do not produce this evidence. All 17 launch
requirements remain unqualified.

This directory deliberately contains no application capture, credentials, real
store paths or fabricated saved IDs. The independent acceptance owner binds the
cards to one admitted Rails fixture and its exact artifact tuple. Use the same
meaningful model-investigation questions as Map, starting with where/how Order
schedules its receipt, what contributes that behavior and what model data and
relationships to inspect. Preserve the broader feature-planning and intermittent
mailing questions even where this initial surface cannot answer them.

`expected_cards.json` defines questions and required distinctions, rather than
asserting answers unsupported by current Core. `protocol_cases.json` defines
negative, lifecycle, pinning and traversal checks. The installed probe in
`../../installed_client.rb` checks protocol and direct Reader equality only.
`investigation_protocol.md` specifies actual client/recipient acceptance.

`client-config.example.json` is an intentionally non-runnable, secret-free
portable stdio example. Substitute an explicitly selected saved SHA and a private
operator-owned store location in an isolated authorized client configuration.
It is a generic MCP configuration shape, not a claim that an installed Codex or
Claude version has accepted this file. Do not modify global client settings.
